The structure of Zn2Cu10Se8 (reduced formula ZnCu5Se4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral environments for Cu and Se centers, with Cu–S/Zn distances near 2.33–2.46 Å and Se centers surrounded by four Cu neighbors. The Cu tetrahedra show both corner- and edge-sharing contacts, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
